### Casualties: Unknown Archipelago v0.13.0 This update is compatible with worlds generated on versions 0.13.0-pre3 and above!
For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/CUAP/blob/master/README.md). Development on the Itch.io version of Casualties: Unknown has stopped. To play this mod on the Itch.io version, use CUAP v0.8.0. Development on the Steam Demo version of Casualties: Unknown has stopped. To play this mod on the Steam Demo version, use CUAP v0.12.3.
# Additions - Support Casualties: Unknown 1.0.2 [APWorld Change] - Craftsanity now gives you the option to exclude the new Merc Scarf [APWorld Change] - New goals for getting each ending [APWorld Change] - Sawian Unlocks YAML option [APWorld Change] - Goal Requires All Sawians YAML option [APWorld Change] - New `apchecksawians` command to check your progress - Unlock Brainchip YAML option [APWorld Change] - Minigame Randomization now includes the Prosthesis Repair and Hand-Crank minigames [APWorld Change] - Certain hardware setups cause BepInEx to load before the game does. Instructions to fix this now print to the log - Limb Unlocks have had a complete rework [APWorld Change] - Now all limbs start as wood prosthesis and must be upgraded through items - Sawblades, Pistons, Guards, Lava lamps, both types of Ceiling turrets, Cryo-drones, and Pus sacks now drop Archipelago Items # Changes - Proguseful (Progression + Useful) items now appear gold inside the console, similar to how other games handle it - The window title now shows the mod version - Reworded option descriptions to use correct terminology regarding locations and checks [APWorld Change] - The Defeat Elder Thornback goal removes all locations after Overgrown Depths [APWorld Change] - The default depth for a Reach Depth goal is now 2700 [APWorld Change] - Critical barotrauma has been added to the Deadly Moodlesanity exclusions preset [APWorld Change] - Barotrauma, Critical barotrauma, and Bent prosthesis have been added to the Difficult Moodlesanity exclusions preset [APWorld Change] - Changed some of the option groups around [APWorld Change] - The mod now disables Steam Achievements on startup - You can now remove the Cargo without the Minigames item when Minigame Randomization is set to As One - Replaced all instances of "Experiment" with "the Sawian" in option descriptions [APWorld Change] - Colored instances of the word "Archipelago" now visually cycle colors from left -> right instead of right -> left - Updated KaitoKid.ArchipelagoUtilities.Net to 3.1.16 - Internal bleeding and Hemothorax no longer logically require a living limb, as you can get both from impact damage and traps [APWorld Change] - This is technically true for the bleeding moodles themselves as well, but that sounds unfun - Dislocations now logically require a living limb [APWorld Change] - Specifically "Moodlesanity - Dislocated limb". Specific moodles like "Dislocated spine" do work with prosthesis - The automatic starting layer reselection when selecting an invalid layer now includes layers after Overgrown Depths [APWorld Change] # Fixes - Fixed Craftsanity - Riot helmet not requiring any INT with Skillsanity enabled [APWorld Change] - Fixed Craftsanity location logic requirements leaking between generations [APWorld Change] - This could only be seen when the Python instance was not terminated between generations, such as with a fuzzer or a generate until successful script - Fixed the "Deadly and Difficult" Moodlesanity Exclusions preset making generation fail [APWorld Change] - Tweaked EnergyLink to hopefully fix it not working sometimes - Fixed not being able to receive Skills in a run after saving and reloading it - Fixed Sawian Unlocks not locking Sawians after exiting to the main menu after a run/tutorial - Fixed Sawian Unlocks always being enabled modside # Known Issues - A NullReferenceException is sometimes thrown when the Layer Selector opens. This seems to be an issue with how Harmony interacts with Prefix patches on IEnumerators - If more than one Archipelago Item exists, they will all share the same sprite and description. This is a limitation of the original game - Craftsanity checks will still be sent if crafting fails due to low INT. This is a bug in the original game
**Full Changelog (from last pre-release)**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/CUAP/compare/v0.13.0-pre4...v0.13.0 **Full Changelog (from last stable)**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/CUAP/compare/v0.12.3...v0.13.0

entry.title: Grand Theft Auto III v0.4.0
entry.content:
Weapon licenses, a save file between sessions, and $10000 to fill the pool. Use the plugin and the APWorld of this release together, and generate a new room for it.
## What's new
- **Weapon licenses**: nine weapons the shops sell are items (Uzi, shotgun, AK-47, M-16, sniper rifle, rocket launcher, flamethrower, Molotov cocktail, grenade). A shop shows the weapon out of stock until you receive its license; the pistol and the body armour are sold as in the game. - **$10000**: the only extra item, which fills the rest of the pool. - **Excluded locations** (`exclude_locations`): each one takes the place of a license, from the grenade's back, and gets a $10000; that weapon is then sold as in the game. A room of GTA III alone can fill 9 at most. - **`start_inventory_from_pool`**: start with items taken out of the pool, like `Uzi License: 1`; each one leaves a $10000 in its place. - **Between sessions**: GTA3 Client keeps your money, health, armour and weapons in a save file of its own, one per room (`gta3_saves` in Archipelago's folder). A new game started with **Run Archipelago** gets them back, with the items received in the meantime, and never gives an item twice. - **Received items**: items that arrive together show in one message, for 3 seconds; a new message takes the place of the previous one.
## Known limitations
- The missions passed do not come back between sessions: a new game starts the story again. Play a run in one session for now. - Saving and loading a game is not supported yet. - Only `gta3.exe` 1.0 is supported: downgrade the Steam copy first (see the README's *Steam version* section). - With `need_money` on, the logic counts no money: you may have to earn it in the game. - Played far out of the story's order, a mission may still rely on something an earlier one sets up. Please report the ones that break.
## Installation
You need GTA III for PC **version 1.0**, Archipelago **0.6.7** or newer, and the ASI loader [Ultimate ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/latest/download/Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip) (32-bit, `Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip`, not the `_x64` one).
1. Put the `dinput8.dll` of `Ultimate-ASI-Loader.zip` next to `gta3.exe`. 2. Put `GTA3Archipelago.asi` in the `scripts` folder next to `gta3.exe` (create it if needed). 3. Double-click `gta3.apworld` to install it in Archipelago, or copy it into Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder. 4. Write your YAML (`game: Grand Theft Auto III`, with the options of the README) and generate or join a room. 5. Open **GTA3 Client** from the Archipelago Launcher and connect to the room. 6. Start GTA III and choose **Run Archipelago** in the main menu. Keep GTA3 Client open while you play.
Coming from 0.3.0: replace both files with this release's, and generate a new room.
## Files
- `GTA3Archipelago.asi`: the game plugin, for the `scripts` folder. - `gta3.apworld`: the GTA III world and GTA3 Client, for Archipelago. - `README.md`: how it plays, the options, and the full installation guide. - `LICENSE-MinHook.txt`: the license of MinHook, which the plugin contains.

entry.title: Nine Sols v0.7.0
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/NineSolsArchipelagoRandomizer?tab=readme-ov-file#installation).
- **Entrance randomization** is finally here. - The new options are `randomize_entrances` (default false, obviously) and `coupled_entrances` (default true). If you weren't aware: "coupled" ER guarantees that whenever A goes to B, B also goes back to A. Uncoupled ER is much harder to navigate. - `randomize_entrances: true` randomizes 51 two-way connections and 4 one-way connections between areas. Or to put it another way: there are 106 portals you can run or fall into which (after a loading screen) take you somewhere different than they did in vanilla. - Many other connections are intentionally left unrandomized. Examples include the Central Hall connections to FSP and Control Hub/Eigong, the Jiequan 1 fight into Prison, Lady E's soulscape entrance, the big elevators that have more than two destinations, the connections between each part of Peach Blossom Village, and the doors into various "puzzle rooms" and "enemy gauntlet rooms". - Universal Tracker support has also been updated for ER. For now this is only "basic" ER support, i.e. whether a square is red or green should correctly account for how the entrances have been randomized in your slot, but none of UT's ER-specific features have been implemented yet.

entry.title: Animal Crossing v0.6.0rc1
entry.content:
This is a RELEASE CANDIDATE for 0.6.0, which means don't play this version unless you're OK with potential crashes and graphical issues and want to report them to help me get the release ready!
If you do want to help, **set your graphics to Vulkan in the Video settings menu**. Then, open an issue or send a message in the Archipelago discord if you run into issues. Include your OS and your graphics card, and ofc what happened.
- **Update to SDL3:** you shouldn't notice any difference, but this is a newer backend library and may bring more compatibility with newer setups (old setups should not change; if they do let me know). - If you are on Linux + Wayland, it will now use the native Wayland output instead of X11 through a translation layer - With the update to SDL3, **button positions are now used instead of face label**. In practice, this means that you will get the Nintendo layout regardless of controller. It is easy to restore with the controller setup; just part of SDL3 (sorry). - **New Vulkan Renderer:** alternative to OpenGL if you find OpenGL buggy (or laggy? they should be roughly the same speed though) - **Easier Critters Upgrade:** bugs can now spawn on ANY flower (old AC they can't spawn on tulips) and will spawn on the outer 2 rows/columns of an acre (they couldn't in the original). - **Fossil tracker:** new fossil tracker like bugs, fish, and shells in the AP pause menu - **Crash fix outdoors:** crash from outdoor furniture fixed (random) - **Missing critter fix:** under rare circumstances, the last bug in a spawn table may never spawn. it should now - **Fix may windsocks:** they properly spawn and despawn now - **Fix birthday + starsign:** showed as 'iiiiiiiii' if you had instant text on - **Timesanity forces bugs cleanly into time slots:** before, you could catch some bugs "out of logic" for 1 hour, which might've been confusing - **Mini tracker shows shells + more consistent found/available output** - **More lenient generation:** if random is selected for pools where the final result could be beyond the allowed amount, the random value is rerolled to fit into the proper range. Also, goal: random doesn't choose goals that can't work with the current settings - **Pushing or pulling furniture no longer carries you across an acre:** sorry, it was very broken - **Precompiled shaders option** - **Show graphics error if OpenGL 3.3 not found** - **More information when a ROM doesn't match or is not found**

entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.30.1
entry.content:
# v0.30.2 — School Trip tracking and item delivery
Game client **0.77.2** · APWorld **0.30.1**
- Universal Tracker waits for Boring Room completion and Important Letters delivery before showing School Trip on seeds with the open Lobby doors. School Trip still needs Lobby Access and its generated Star count. Demolition Training can be skipped. - Received cassettes can reach the active save during play and persist after deposit. Plant Pipes, Hip Glasses and Chicken Bucket grants now recognize the newer route settings. - Earned checks survive disconnects and restarts. The client validates the room and save before applying pending deliveries. Temporary outages retry automatically, and login errors that need attention appear in the log. - The client does less repeated work during songs and handles reloading the plugin more reliably.
## Updating
Close the game and install **RhythmCastleAP-v0.77.2.zip**. Replace **scrc.apworld** on the computer running Universal Tracker or generating seeds, then restart Archipelago. Reconnect to your existing room and use its associated save. School Trip's live status uses Universal Tracker's default deferred-entrance setting.
The School Trip route was checked in game at four and five Stars with Demolition Training unfinished. The corrected availability was checked separately in Universal Tracker v0.2.32 using that seed. The Gecko variant still needs a separate in-game test.

entry.title: Outer Wilds v1.4.2
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/OuterWildsArchipelagoRandomizer#installation).
- Fixed a bug where our attempt at backwards compatibility for Deep Bramble Coordinates would incorrectly delete your Interstellar Warp Drive - `upgrade_counts` now supports `0`s, and the vanilla stat will remain at 100% when `0` is chosen instead of starting at 50% - If you're still using the Capacity/Duration mod settings, please switch to the new yaml options soon and tell us if there's something you can't accomplish with them. - This is a reminder that I want to **remove the mod settings** in a future version. In fact, there are already some minor bugs visible because of trying to support too many different options/settings around these stats. - All of the timeouts for network operations have been increased, most from 2 seconds to 5 seconds. You should see far fewer scary orange messages now, and when you do see one it's more likely to indicate a real problem. - `early_key_item` can now be `interstellar_warp_drive` or (for FC spawns) `signalscope` - Tweaked the in-game tracker's logic display to stop adding more region explanations at "Timber Hearth" instead of "Timber Hearth Village". This was an odd inconsistency with the other vanilla planets that probably predates alternate spawns. - Updated `randomize_dark_bramble_layout` description to be clearer about the potential challenges - 1.4.1 fixed `required_friends: 10`, but 1.4.1's example yaml did not include this fix, which confused at least one player. entry.title: The Bazaar v0.9.5
entry.content:
Prettier pictures, a smarter Item Guide, a Tracker you can read at a glance, and padlocks that keep up with the game.
**Seeds made with v0.9.4 keep working** - just swap in the new apworld and reconnect.
## New - **Sharper card pictures** in the right shape (Small and Large items are no longer cropped), shown in the game's own rarity frames in pop-ups and the Item Guide. - **The Shop Guide is now the Item Guide**, with a **Hero filter** (starts on the hero you're playing), merchant pools that match what each merchant really sells, "You can buy" listed above "Locked", and walking into a shop picks that merchant for you. - **Tracker**: each square has an icon (sunrise = reach the day, clashing swords = PvP win, snake = monsters, trophy = 10 wins), and every hero shows a check progress bar plus how many of its checks and cards you have - the same as the main menu's hero panel. - **AP markers** on monster and PvP fight cards that still have a check for you. - **The padlock goes on the copy you have to sell** - holding two copies of a card, only the one that blocks checks gets it. A card hit by a **Sell Trap** shows a burning skull instead. - **Selling a card that gives you something** (packages, Shipment, Pinata, Safe, Raffle Ticket...) no longer blocks checks with what it gives you, under Created Items = Special Cases. - **Redesigned pop-ups**: one at a time over your hero, with every picture, and they wait while a menu or loading screen covers them.
## Fixed - Padlocks follow the cards smoothly at the game's frame rate, and the client uses less CPU. - Padlocks and markers fade under every game tooltip now - a monster's rewards, the PvP opponent, level-ups, sell prices. - The Esc menu and loading screens only hide the parts of the overlay that sit on the game: a Tracker or Item Guide on another monitor stays put. - The Use Bypass button no longer hides under the game's settings gear. - A previous pop-up no longer flashes for a frame before the new one.
Install: download `bazaar.apworld` below and double-click it (or put it in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder).

entry.title: Crash Team Racing v0.3.0a5
entry.content:
## Discord
Come hang out on [Appie's Games Discord](https://discord.com/invite/HxXy4mKQ5E). Test builds, bug reports and YAML sharing all happen there.
Alpha5 is out! Thanks for all the alpha4 reports. This one fixes a hub crash (thanks BEXUS), checks getting lost when your connection drops and some nasty rendering bugs. It also adds a few things you asked for, like numbers on crates and fruit and a better tracker. It's still an alpha, so 0.2.4 stays the stable release.
[Full notes on AP-Pie](https://ap-pie.com/ctr/releases/0-3-0) · [Setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr)
## Before you try it - Use the alpha5 client and APWorld together. Your alpha4 YAML still works.
## Fixed - A pad that asked for 20 or more of something crashed the game in its hub. It shows up to 99 now. Thanks BEXUS! - A check could get lost just after your connection dropped, and the crate or fruit stayed marked as done. It gets sent again when you reconnect to the same room. Thanks SoraKH13! - Play Solo stopped with an error before the track list if you had downloaded a track for a seed whose folder has a version number, like Baby T Park. Fixed. - Crates and fruit now show what you sent and who got it when the item is for someone else. Thanks BEXUS! - A beaten Pinstripe garage lost its star on the hub map. It's red now, like the other garages. Thanks SoraKH13! - Beating a boss with the same racer as the boss broke the podium: both of you played the losing animation and then vanished. Fixed. Thanks sturg! - Stadium walls and stands could lose pieces at mid distance, and in widescreen a green wedge could cut into the road. Both fixed. - Increase Draw Distance doesn't leave cracks in towers and roofs anymore, and in split screen it takes effect straight away when you switch it on mid-race. - Really busy scenes, like North Pole with Increase Draw Distance on, could blow up into long spikes across the screen. Fixed. - Backing out of a warp pad left your kart without engine sound. It's back. Thanks FruitLion8! - The hub behind the name entry is complete now: no more red triangles over the warp pads, and the doors, garages, pad beams and trophies are all there. - Crystal Challenges with Itemsanity only hand out the useful weapons now: Turbo, Bomb, Missile, Shield and Mask. Thanks Dex!
## New - Crate and fruit numbers: turn on OPTIONS > Archipelago > Crate / Fruit Numbers and crates and fruit that are checks show their number, so you can tell which one is Wumpa Crate 12. Off by default. Thanks Dex! - In the in-game tracker, press Square on a track to see its Reach 10 Wumpa, crate and fruit progress. - Random pad requirements grow with your item pool. More Trophies, Tokens or Relics in the pool means pads can ask for more, fewer means less. The default pool gives the same pads as before. - If your client can't use the room's APWorld version, the connection screen says so, and which client to use when it can tell. - Checked Wumpasanity and Itemboxsanity crates and fruit go back to their normal colour instead of grey. Thanks MarioSpore! - Several Laps Per Driver: with recorded AI laps from just one or two people, their other laps can fill the empty lanes. It's off by default, you'll find it in OPTIONS under Authoring. Thanks Dex! - Tizi Madness and Adventure Path are the names of two Coco Team Racing tracks now. On Tizi Madness your weapon slot refills with a Mask (with Itemsanity, once you've found the Mask). Seeds only use it with hard shortcut knowledge. - Lots more camera shots in the hub behind the name entry.
## Known issues - Lots of Saphi tracks are Time Trial only, so they can't be used in a seed yet. - The in-game tracker still doesn't list every check, like podium places, perfect relic races and cup rewards. - Some unusual YAMLs still fail to generate. Send me the YAML if it keeps happening.
## Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/dowlle/ctr-native-ap/issues/new/choose) or post it on the Discord. Add your YAML and the support bundle (`support-bundle.bat` or `support-bundle.sh`) if you can.
## Thanks Thanks to BEXUS, SoraKH13, MarioSpore, Dex, sturg and FruitLion8 for the reports and ideas behind this one. The wall piece, widescreen and draw distance fixes come from [CTR Native Expanded](https://github.com/thecodingbob/ctr-native), thanks to its authors. Thanks to AlienGenie for the Always Jumping trap (he's in the credits now), and to FrostedWombat for the Coco Team Racing tracks and the OK to import them.
## Downloads Windows: `ctr-archipelago-v0.3.0-alpha5-windows-x86.zip`. Linux or Steam Deck: `ctr-archipelago-v0.3.0-alpha5-linux-x86.tar.gz`. Both include the client, the matching `ctr.apworld` and Play Solo. You need your own NTSC-U copy of the game. The client is GPL-3.0; the source is the `v0.3.0-alpha5` tag.

entry.title: TimeSplitters Future Perfect v1.5.0
entry.content: ## New Features - **Archipelago Shop** - A Shop has been added in-game! The "View Movies" menu in Extras has been turned into a Shop where you can spend points on Archipelago Items! Extras has been renamed to "Extras & Shop", and "View Movies" has been renamed to "Archipelago Shop". The Shop holds 15 items, and items are priced based on their item type (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap). Depending on how many Shop Locations (Max 75) you've chosen in your YAML, "Progressive Shop Restock" items are added to into the Item Pool. When you purchase an item, it gets sent to the player, and replaces that line with "Purchased". If you have a Shop Restock item, any "Purchased" line gets replaced with the next in-line item to buy. You can earn points by the following methods: > 1. Getting Kills in any mode, counted as you make them, 1 Kill = 1 Point. > 2. Earning Trophies in Arcade/Challenges, worth 10/20/30/40, counting the lower grades > 3. Completing Story Levels based on difficulty 15/35/50, counting the easier difficulties > 4. New Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum Trophy Filler Items. - **Progressive Damage Resistances** - 5 Resistance types, Bullet, Explosive, Fire, Plasma and Melee. 6 of each, adding 10% Resistance of that type. - **Familiarity with TimeSplitters 2** - Items for TimeSplitters 2 are recognised by TimeSplitters: Future Perfect, and will have shortened names in the Awards Screen & Shop. So instead of "Challenge - Behead the Undead - Sergio's Last Stand", it will show as "Sergio's Last Stand" in the Awards Screen & Shop. > *Must be TimeSplitters 2 (PurpleHeart's Version)* - **Inventory Tab** - Weapon Buffs tab has been renamed to "Inventory Tab", which shows a Read-Only view of all items in the Shop and how many Points you have. It shows all your Resistances, Damage Buffs, Score Multipliers and Progressive Starting Armour. - **Award Screen Changes** - New Headers such as "RESERVE AMMO BUFF FOUND!", "CLIP SIZE BUFF FOUND!", "SCORE MULTIPLIER FOUND!", "DAMAGE RESISTANCE FOUND!" to reduce the amount of text on the awards screen. Story Levels now include their Year in their name.

entry.title: Crash2 v0.5.0rc2
entry.content:
## New Stuff: - Added the "Dig" ability to ability lock - Fixed being able to break boxes with the slide when slide is disabled - Changed some wording in the yaml and disabled life count checks by default - Updated the Archipelago version of the Apworld to make use of rule builder - I tested it on AP 0.6.8, older versions may not work ### Finished Ability Lock Logic: - Every check in the game now has logic for ability lock - Two logic levels: - Normal: what I reasonably expect is doable for a player that is capable of beating the game casually - Lunatic: defines the absolute minimum abilities required for each check - Not recommended to play on this setting (you may be required to do some insane tech) - Playing on Normal will show Lunatic level checks as yellow in Universal Tracker, so that you know what is possible to do when you're BKed - Other logic settings do not have glitched logic support in UT. For example if you have jetpack lock logic set to basic, all the checks in Rock It and Pack Attack will be out of logic instead of showing what is possible in yellow - Using gameover abuse to collect crystals is not considered as in logic - There is one edge case that I have not covered yet in Lunatic logic (there's like a "one in a million" chance that it could create an impossible seed when using Lunatic logic and some other specific settings) - Collecting a check outside of logic can be considered a bug, unless it's with gameover abuse or there's a different logic option that puts that check out of logic - Likewise, it can be a bug if a check in normal or glitched logic isn't obtainable, although it could just be that you don't know how to get it
## Bugs & To-Do - Life count checks sometimes don't collect (for some unknown reason) - Crash is able to slide and spin on ice when slide / ground spin are locked - The [Issues](https://github.com/Sim10XXX/C2AP/issues) page is updated with everything that's on my radar

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.4.0
entry.content:
> [!WARNING] > Both Slay the Spire II and this Archipelago Mod are in active development. As such, while this _is_ playable, expect there to be bugs and limited features. We appreciate your playtesting! > [!IMPORTANT] > **Play on the game's beta branch.** Main-branch support is on thin ice but supported none the less: the mod still runs there, but it's largely untested and new game features might not be supported on it. ## Setup For installation, YAML configuration, generation and connection instructions, see [the Slay the Spire II setup guide](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/blob/setup-docs-do-not-delete/world/spire2/docs/setup_en.md). Archipelago **Launcher v0.6.7+** is required for generation. Install **STS2-RitsuLib 0.6.11+** separately. The newest YAML Builder is at [sts2ap.terairk.dev](https://sts2ap.terairk.dev/#/builder), and the mod's **Mod Website & YAML Builder** button opens it. [sts2ap.net](https://sts2ap.net/#/builder) gets the new options later. # Version Information - **Archipelago Client:** 2.2.0 - **APWorld:** 1.4.0 - **Slay the Spire II main branch:** v0.111.1 - **Slay the Spire II beta branch:** v0.113.1 Older game versions (0.107.1, 0.111.0 and 0.113.0) no longer get their own build, since Steam moves everyone to the latest version of their branch. Hopefully this doesn't break anything # Changelist ## Major changes ### Boons The opposite of Challenges: a new opt-in **Boons** option with helpful modifiers for every run. **Logic doesn't account for them, and they're all off by default.** - **Wayfinder:** three times per act, travel to any room in the next row, ignoring the paths. - **Second Wind:** once per act, survive a killing blow and heal 25% of your max HP. - **Ember Enchanting:** campfires let you enchant a card with a random enchantment. Uses up the campfire and needs the same Progressive Smith as upgrading. - **Compound Interest:** at the start of Acts 2 and 3, gain 20% of the gold you hold, up to 100. - **Gilded:** gain 30% more gold, including gold from AP items. - **Spring Cleaning:** after the Act 1 and Act 2 bosses, choose one: remove a card, transform a card, or upgrade 2 random cards. - **Loyal Customer:** each purchase makes the rest of that shop 15% cheaper, up to 45%. AP checks in the shop count and get the discount too. - **Campfire Brewing:** once per campfire, brew a random potion. You can still rest or upgrade afterwards. - **Endless Upgrades:** cards can be upgraded any number of times. Each upgrade adds the card's upgrade bonus again. Wayfinder and Second Wind show up as relics, so you can see how many uses are left this act. Only Compound Interest, Gilded, Loyal Customer and Endless Upgrades work in multiplayer, where the host's choice applies to the whole run. ### Sight Bonuses Sight items felt like pure hindrances, so a **second copy** of a Sight item now gives a bonus on top of undoing its Hidden option: - **Intent Sight:** start each combat with **Forewarned**: for each enemy whose attacks your Block stops completely on its turn, draw 1 more card next turn. - **Health Sight:** gain **Aged Cheese**: after defeating an Elite or a boss, raise your Max HP by 3. - **Pile Sight:** the draw pile shows cards in the order you'll draw them. - **Map Sight:** a **Scouting** list under the map legend shows your next 2 fights, your next elite and what your next 2 ? rooms will be. Rooms you can move to next say what's in them. - **Card Sight:** card rewards offer 1 more card, and Act 1 card rewards can be upgraded. The Hidden options now go up to 4 copies, and the new `sight_bonuses` option lets you leave a Sight at its normal level. **Logic counts each bonus as extra power in Act 3** when its second copy is in the pool. It's only there to give a bonus in act 3 to not influence its placements too much so you're still punished for it but also get a major upside. Also so it counts as progression so people don't skip it in shops. The Intent, Health and Card bonuses are singleplayer only. Pile and Map work in multiplayer. This is going to be a frequent thing going forwards: where somethings just aren't supported in multiplayer because they're insanely complex to work in multiplayer. ### More Bonus Items Bonus Items aren't just wax relics anymore. The new kinds: - **Relic:** a relic that stays for the whole run, from chosen pools or one specific relic. - **Enchantment:** choose a card to enchant, from a rarity pool or one named enchantment. - **Enchanted Cards:** a card reward whose cards are all enchanted. - **Max HP:** gain a set amount of max HP. - **Cards:** choose 1 of 3 cards from pools like `Regent Attack` or `Colorless Rare`, optionally upgraded, or one named card. Three new enchantments of the mod's own come with them: - **Checkbound** (Rare): +1 damage per hit and +1 Block as your character's checks pass 5, 12, 22, 36, 55 and 80% of its locations, up to +6. Singleplayer only. - **Eager** (Uncommon): the first time the card is drawn each combat, it costs 1 less until played. - **Exposing** (Uncommon): Attacks apply 1 Vulnerable to what they hit. ### Events in Any Act `events_in_any_act: true` lets events show up in any act instead of only their usual ones. Event fights and rewards aren't adjusted for the act you meet them in. Singleplayer only. ### Keyboard only and controller support - AP buttons (pickers, run recap, Past AP Runs) can now be pressed with Space, Enter or controller A. Before this you couldn't even start an AP run from the checkpoint picker without a mouse. - The AP shop page works with keyboard and controller, and the page buttons switch with the game's tab keys (Q/F, LB/RB). - L3 opens the AP Loot menu when Steam Input is off. ### YAML Builder The Checks & Rewards step was way too long, so the builder now has separate **Checks**, **Shops**, **Item Pool** and **Boons** steps. The Boons step marks which boons are solo only, and Blitz Merchant Chance moved there. ---
Full details ### Logic and generation - The **Use New Logic** option is gone; new logic is always used. Old logic is only kept as the automatic fallback for a singleplayer world with floor, gold and potion checks all off. - Sight items are deprioritized and skip progression balancing, so generation treats them more like a nice surprise. - Shop Card, Shop Colorless Card, Shop Relic and Shop Potion Slots skip progression balancing; they only add a little to logic each. - New **Sights** item group, so `!hint Sights` finds a way out of a Hidden challenge. It also works in `local_items` and `start_hints`. - The **Gold** item group no longer includes One Gold and Five Gold, so `!hint Gold` doesn't waste a hint on filler. - Universal Tracker keeps the slot's Sight Bonuses when it regenerates a slot. ### Cards, relics and rewards - Each Combat, Elite and Boss Gold item now counts as its own gold gain, so relics like Dragon Fruit trigger once per item instead of once per claim. One and Five Gold filler still count as a single gain. - Spring Cleaning's choice after a boss now removes the other options once you take one. ### Website and YAML - Item Pool: only wax relics are shown in sepia; the other Bonus Item kinds keep their colours. - Sight Bonuses question in Challenges. ### Fixes and other changes - The character tracker now fills in for the character that's actually selected when you open character select, instead of the first button (usually Ironclad). - Supports main **0.111.1** and beta **0.113.1**. The Dread Dominion tooltip on the boss icon lays out properly again on 0.113.1.
## Version compatibility Works on previous multiworld versions. Use the updated APWorld and client together. Boons, Sight Bonuses, the new Bonus Items and Events in Any Act need both. Seeds generated with APWorld 1.3.0 get every Sight Bonus with client 2.2.0 once a second copy of a Sight arrives. Everyone in a multiplayer lobby should use the same client version and game branch. ## Known Issues/Limitations - **Main branch:** largely untested and gets no new features. Main-branch multiplayer will stop being supported in a future release. - Dread Mode: a Double Boss Ascension Down that arrives during Act 3 removes the second boss but keeps its Dominion until the boss fight; after a reload the first boss's Dominion applies. - In multiplayer, AP menu rewards can only be claimed outside combat; Death Fragments are disabled. **Anytime** Ancient rewards are recommended. - Hidden Cards still shows each card's type and frame colour, and you can work a card out from the energy it spends or what it does when played. - Several Boons, three Sight Bonuses, Checkbound and Events in Any Act are singleplayer only.

entry.title: Paper Mario v0.6.9
entry.content:
## Bugfixes/Corrections
* Logic * Toad Town * Fix `Open Blue House: True` not actually doing anything logically, and still expecting finding the `OddKey` to open the house from the outside. * Toad Town Tunnels * Fix logic erroneously requiring `SuperBoots` for building the chapter 7 block bridge if `Chapter 7 bridge visible` was turned on. This fix will now put chapter 7 in logic much earlier if the bridge is always visible. * Shooting Star Summit * Fix reaching the top of the summit being in logic while jumpless with Parakarry. Logic now expects the `Boots`. * Mt. Rugged * Fix the train station bushes logically requiring `Boots` to reach. * Bowser's Castle * Fix the basement jail / lava channels area being logically reachable without `Watt`. * Fix `BC Lava Channel 3 On Island 1` being considered reachable without the boots while the lava is still active. * Fix `BC Lava Channel 3 On Island 2` only being considered reachable with the boots, even though Parakarry suffices. * Misc * Minor fixes and adjustments to logic all over the place. These include removing redundant progress checks (which may speed up seed generation), and proper fixes that will only matter once glitch options or entrance shuffle are available. * Automated AP Tests * Fix several test fails this apworld caused during the `general` set of automated AP tests.
## Other
* Map Names * Fix typo: Rename `Koopa Bros.' Fortress` map `Right Starway` to `Right Stairway`. * YAML options * `Cutscene Mode` now defaults to `Minimal`. * `Chet Rippo Available` now defaults to `True`.

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.6.0rc1
entry.content:
Release candidate **v0.6.0-rc1**, built from merged main commit `46a64fd64e4bab238f9f6c4755eb5f4050c0e6f5` (PR #1116). This is a prerelease for testing, not the stable release.
Install **kirbyam.apworld**; it contains the committed patch, not a full game ROM. The provenance receipt and signed attestation bundle are verification files. Regenerate seeds to use the new placement logic; updating the APWorld does not rewrite existing seeds.
Remaining physical-acquisition and encounter coverage is tracked in [v1.0.0 follow-up #1122](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/issues/1122). The changes below do not claim complete route coverage or a completed full playthrough.
## v0.6.0
### New Features - Add 100% Game Completion Goal: all rooms, chests, levers, Big Switches, and Dark Mind clear. Health upgrades do not add completion requirements since there can be a variable amount (Issue #204). - Added "Phone a Friend" as a standard progression item (PR #1086). This gates Kirby's ability to call other Kirbys to the player, but not to return to Central Circle. - All sixteen Goal Games award a check when completed, including runs with no prizes (PR #1026). - Add the default-off `Advanced Logic` toggle under `Make the game harder`; enabling it allows reviewed Crash and Magic traversal routes (PR #1092).
### Improvements - Support YAML-less Universal Tracker tracking for newly generated seeds by restoring their resolved settings, enemy ability assignments, starting inventory and excluded locations (PR #1102). - Improve in-game wooden boards over locked area transition mirrors, preserving their original frames (Issue #1027, PR #1105). - Improved Logic for Item Placement and Accessible Locations (PR #1092, PR #1103, Issue #1099).
### Known Limitations - Phone charges can exceed three, but the battery display does not show the extra charges (PR #1086). - Ranged-attack coverage remains incomplete. Three targets retain older rules outside reviewed source assignments; broader physical outcomes still need review. See the [detailed coverage ledger](dev-docs/ranged-coverage-ledger.md) (PR #1052). - Only the North American ROM is supported; AP notifications are English. - Chests retain their original item sprites and collection animations; statues retain their original ability appearance. - mGBA notifications require the visible **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel; they are plain text, not game-image overlays. - Testing covers selected gameplay scenarios, not a complete playthrough or every multiplayer setup.
### Bug Fixes - Logic previously only cared if you unlocked an ability, not if it was actually obtainable from an enemy or statue. This is fixed. Miniboss and area boss spawns are also considered but only under the new Advanced Logic option (PR #1116). - Corrected the Chalk chest compartment (PR #1086). - Keep the Mustard Mountain Room 15 timed exit out of logic when no reviewed source-backed route is available, including mixed/failable source policies (Issue #1099). The ordinary Room 17 bypass remains available.
### Internal Changes - Detailed Phone source and historical validation records remain in the [Phone documentation](dev-docs/phone-progression-admission.md) (PR #1086). - Record bounded Rainbow Route East Map Chest acquisition, independent native cold persistence and real-server delivery evidence; full-goal acceptance remains pending. - Validate receipt-first Carrot Castle physical save/cold-load in all three native files using real starting-item delivery; full-goal acceptance remains pending. - Extend bounded Moonlight physical-first real-server reconnect validation to all three native files; this is not full-completion acceptance. - Persist physical lever pulls alongside seed-bound Hub checks without granting wall ownership or changing the native save layout.
